title: RgGen
_note: The chipsalliance/sv-tests core (generators/rggen), pinned at the two commits sv-tests pins.  TWO repos: rggen-sv-rtl is the hand-written register-file library, rggen-sample the GENERATED blocks (block_0 / block_1) that instantiate it -- sv-tests compiles both together and tops them with a generated `rggen` wrapper.  No include directories.  NOTE rggen_or_reducer.sv is the module whose recursive OR-reduction tree was truncated by the compound-assignment RHS alias fixed in chipsalliance/UHDM#1162; this sweep exercises that path.
